sections.explanation: The mean is sum divided by count; the median is the middle ordered value, averaging the two middle values for an even count. Range is maximum minus minimum. Population standard deviation is the square root of the average squared departure from the mean; the sample convention divides by n−1 instead. State which convention you use. Random variation creates scatter; a systematic offset can shift all readings together. Low scatter does not establish accuracy. A sample is not automatically representative of its population.
